concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-017 (lag‑1 autocorrelation check) and Success Criterion SC-012 are not covered by any task. Add a concrete task (e.g., T017) that computes the lag‑1 autocorrelation on the final i.i.d. point‑estimate dataset, verifies |ρ₁| < 0.1, and includes a pytest validation step.
